semiconductor_relevance: High — Innovation Science provides specialized equipment and analytical tools crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Innovation Science is a key player in the semiconductor manufacturing equipment sector, offering advanced plasma analysis and surface engineering tools. They are the exclusive distributor in Japan for HIDEN ANALYTICAL and Henniker Scientific, focusing on enhancing material properties and process efficiencies.
capabilities: Real-time gas analyzers for semiconductor applications
Mass spectrometers for advanced thin film analysis
Plasma generators for material wettability enhancement
